svg.desc: A transformer block drawn as a vertical residual stream. Each sub-layer reads a normalised copy of the stream, computes a result, and adds it back. RMSNorm then attention form the first residual step; RMSNorm then the SwiGLU MLP form the second. The stream itself is never normalised, so gradient passes straight through.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The residual stream runs straight down. Everything else is a correction to it.

svg.text: Because the stream is only ever ADDED to: a block whose output is near zero does nothing,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and gradient flows straight down the line. That is what makes a 36-layer stack trainable.
